checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~10 s widescreen video with friendly intelligible English voice-over
must.why: Only two clips (4 s and 3 s, about 7 s) were delivered. The first clip is silent and the second has sound. Whether the words are intelligible cannot be judged.

must.item: Water rises as vapor, clouds form, rain falls in order
must.why: Vapor and clouds are shown, but no rain appears in any frame and the precipitation clip is missing.

must.item: Labels read exactly Evaporation, Condensation, Precipitation
must.why: Evaporation and Condensation are spelled correctly, but Precipitation is absent.

must.item: Each label legible and with its stage, in order
must.why: Evaporation is legible for the whole clip. Condensation is visible at 0.3 s but gone by 1.2 s, so it does not stay for its stage. There is no Precipitation label.

faults.what: The Precipitation stage is missing. There is no rain and no Precipitation label.
The Condensation label disappears after the first moments, although it should stay for the whole stage.
The total is about 7 s instead of 10 s.
The Evaporation clip is silent, so the voice-over does not cover the first stage.
The Evaporation label grows larger across the clip, and there is little visible vapor rising.
The Condensation label is low-contrast against the clouds.

summary: Only the Evaporation (4 s, silent) and Condensation (3 s, label fades out early) clips exist, with no rain, no Precipitation label and about 7 s total, so the video is incomplete.
